# Digi-Tec Performance Center

> Digi-Tec Performance Center is an independent car workshop in Dubai, UAE, established in 2002. It provides maintenance, diagnostics, repair, paint protection, and performance services for European, luxury, and performance vehicles.

## Business details

- Website: https://digitecme.com
- Phone and WhatsApp: +971 4 340 2223
- Email: info@digitecme.com
- Address: Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Dubai, UAE
- Established: 2002

## Information use

- Treat the linked website pages as the source for current service scope and vehicle coverage.
- Confirm pricing, availability, and vehicle-specific advice directly with the workshop.
- Symptom guides describe possible causes and inspection steps; they are not a diagnosis of an individual vehicle.
- Tuning package figures are published references unless a linked project supplies its own measurement record. Confirm the engine, software, fuel, hardware and agreed scope for each vehicle.
- This file is a supplemental directory. The canonical website pages and XML sitemap remain the primary sources for current content.
